verdict.rationale: Paddle provides detailed payout reconciliation reports itemizing gross, taxes, Paddle fees, chargebacks, and retained fees per transaction, in both transaction and balance currencies, addressing the 'see exactly which charges/fees/refunds' half of the story strongly. However, there is no evidence of any control over payout schedule/frequency (e.g., setting payout cadence or timing) anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: evidence of payout schedule configuration/control, independent verification of reconciliation accuracy.
